freeze_order: Synthetic-only self-check and exact calibration-source verification, then freeze analyzer/protocol/README/source/coverage/sampling hashes before opening new actual captures.
color_policy: Embedded ICC to sRGB with perceptual intent0; otherwise explicit PNG-sRGB or untagged-sRGB assumption; original profiles and hashes retained.
pair_response: Shape minus paired RGB128-control capture at fixed observed pixels; signed sRGB code RGB, weighted code Yprime and difference of separately linearized Y retained.
global_adaptation_policy: Never subtract remote/global mean, fit a gain, normalize contrast or select a favorable output registration.
android_alignment: Recorded origin, unit world axes, exact density2 and integer crop only; no interpolation, output registration, scaling or rotation.
direction_sectors: Eight [k*45,(k+1)*45)deg sectors about source analytic center, 0deg=image right,90deg=image down, within128px.
radial_bands: [0,r),[r,2r),[2r,4r),[4r,128) using the declared circumradius; beyond128px remains separate.
layers: Nominal selected capsule, broad glyph neighborhoods, nominal base excluding their union, backing text, rim, outside and source coverage are diagnostic overlapping strata; no alpha or material segmentation claim.
AX_policy: Preserve actual AX rectangles and selections as metadata; never call them optical contours or select material pixels from their apparent quality.
components: Exact8-connected threshold components, all sizes, all components; no morphology/filtering/matching across platforms, polarities or thresholds.
weak_response_policy: Keep all thresholds and zero detections; unresolved does not prove disappearance or optical topology.
state_policy: Preserve actual native REST/repeat and Android material themes for control and shape; mismatches remain diagnostic data, without requested-theme substitution.
repeat_policy: Native repeated shape-minus-control response is descriptive only; no repeat correction, confidence interval or unseen Android repeat.
comparisons: Android candidate conditional response minus native REST conditional response; native-repeat conditional response minus native REST; absolute control and shape RGB errors; bare source-world residuals.
